deviations.what: Lab TBT at most 200 ms is not met in every run. /tools/rep/ medians are 174.8 to 202.4 and M8 medians 154.2 to 222.1, on a machine shared with other agents.
deviations.why: On /tools/rep/ the page's own first layout costs about 100 ms of TBT even without JavaScript (removing any one panel stays within noise; removing all five halves it). The hydration task is 106 to 147 ms at 4x, about a third of it first-run engine code. On M8, Chromium autofill reads every form control about 100 ms after one is inserted, a task of about 70 ms each time; inserting the controls together cut this from three readings to two.

deviations.what: Picks on B8, C8 and D8 nodes with 1120 or 1792 positions still produce long tasks.
deviations.why: The owner decided not to change E-9. These tasks are the single minusculeMatrices engine call and the deserialization of the worker reply in the shared lib/worker.ts. Figures are recorded in decisions/P5-A2.md.

requests.what: Switch the M8 challenges b10 to b12 to data-out="state-board" and data-out="state-node" (label text) instead of reading caption text.
Add a verdicts-only or one-relation form of chevalleySerre. The full reply for B8 node 5 (368 records) takes 49 to 56 ms to read at 1x and 149 to 269 ms at 4x.

Size minusculeMatrices for E-9: 92 to 160 ms at 4x on 1792 positions. Also tell the owner of site/components/board/Board.svelte that its first mount on E6 (39 to 50 ms at 4x) caused the one failure in 80 long-task runs.

openQuestions: Should the static-layout cost of /tools/rep/ (about 100 ms of TBT with JavaScript off) and the autofill cost on lessons with many tool instances be handled at page level, outside T12?
handoff: Findings 1-9 and items 10-11 are fixed. Each fix has a test that fails when the fix is reverted (scratch reverts). After hydration T12 draws its controls first in consecutive tasks, then the matrices one per frame, reusing the server's tables until the state changes; basisHeaders now returns one frozen array per basis, so the drawn tables are not rewritten after every change. Still open: the long-task target missed once in 80 runs (a 50 ms Board mount on E6), some lab TBT medians on /tools/rep/ and M8 sit just above 200 ms, and /tools/rep/ is 89.8 kB against its 90 kB limit.
